integrity: The graph and all \(808\) nonempty neighborhood-complex faces are reconstructed from the coordinate definition. A complete Hasse-orientation check proves the archived \(375\)-pair matching acyclic. Integral \(H_1\) is established by explicit determinantal-divisor witnesses for the \(105\times320\) triangle-relation matrix, not by finite-field ranks alone.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the rook/Hamming graph \(H(2,4)\). It does not classify general Hamming, rook, line, or \(6\)-regular graphs, and it does not identify the \(2\)-cell attaching maps beyond the proved integral-homology consequences. An obscure or unindexed equivalent computation under box-complex terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Integral homology of the rook-graph neighborhood complex
